sections.label: The opening
sections.line: MeetScribe: Meet transcripts and a timed debrief on your own key, built in two hours, looking for testers.
sections.para: Business Starter has no Meet recording or transcripts, and upgrading everyone doubles the bill. MeetScribe is a Chrome extension that transcribes the call you are in and writes a debrief on your own OpenRouter key, with no bot and no server, for about 5 to 15 cents an hour. Claude reviewed ChatGPT's brief before building and found four choices that would have produced wrong transcripts without an error. Consent is required; it is a beta.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: No transcripts on Starter; an extension on your own key; cents an hour; built in two hours; consent required.
sections.para: It is a beta, and testers are wanted.

sections.label: The problem
sections.line: Business Starter has no Meet recording or transcripts; Standard is twice the price for every user.
sections.para: Transcription services cost about as much per user, and most join the call as a bot.

sections.label: What MeetScribe does
sections.line: It captures the call, cuts at pauses, transcribes through OpenRouter and writes a timed debrief.
sections.para: It labels You and Meeting, marks echoes and invented phrases instead of deleting them, shows gaps, and reports the cost of each meeting; data stays in the browser.

sections.label: Built in about two hours
sections.line: From an empty repository at 00:15 UTC to v0.3.1 at 02:13, in five commits.
sections.para: About 1,700 lines of code and 45 automated tests, with a pipeline that validates, tests, tags and deploys.

sections.label: The brief that would have failed without an error
sections.line: Claude reviewed ChatGPT's brief first: 14 claims held, 23 findings, four silent failures.
sections.para: Broken audio chunks, silence sent to the model, recording while muted, and the microphone hearing everyone. Building it corrected the second brief too.

sections.label: Consent is yours to get
sections.line: Meet tells participants when it records; MeetScribe asks you to tell them, every meeting.
sections.para: In Portugal, recording words not meant for the public without consent is a crime, even if addressed to you. Audio goes to OpenRouter and a model provider.

sections.label: Try it
sections.line: Five minutes in Chrome 116 or later: download, load unpacked, add a key, tell the others, start.
sections.para: Report tests through the public GitHub form; speaker names, editing, search and the Web Store are not there yet.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: A beta not yet used on a real call; prices as listed on 3 November; not legal advice.
sections.para: Google's annual Standard price is from third-party sites.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The MeetScribe site and repository, Google, OpenRouter, the Penal Code, competitors' pricing pages.
